content.text:
I can't draw Sonic, since he's a protected character, but here's an original runner of my own: Dash, a goggle-wearing jackrabbit with a streaming scarf, mid-sprint across a sunset track.

```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" width="400" height="300">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#2B1B4A"/>
      <stop offset="0.6" stop-color="#E8576B"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#F7B267"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="url(#sky)"/>
  <rect y="235" width="400" height="65" fill="#3D2C5E"/>
  <rect y="235" width="400" height="6" fill="#F4E9D8"/>

  <!-- speed lines -->
  <g stroke="#F4E9D8" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7">
    <line x1="20" y1="140" x2="110" y2="140"/>
    <line x1="40" y1="170" x2="120" y2="170"/>
    <line x1="10" y1="200" x2="100" y2="200"/>
  </g>

  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d="M205 150 Q160 140 120 120 Q150 150 125 165 Q170 160 205 162 Z" fill="#7BD389"/>

  <!-- back leg -->
  <path d="M195 200 Q170 220 150 230" stroke="#C9A27E" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="225" cy="185" rx="45" ry="32" fill="#C9A27E" transform="rotate(-15 225 185)"/>
  <ellipse cx="232" cy="192" rx="24" ry="16" fill="#F4E9D8" transform="rotate(-15 232 192)"/>
  <!-- front leg -->
  <path d="M245 205 Q270 220 285 235" stroke="#B08968" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <ellipse cx="290" cy="236" rx="16" ry="7" fill="#F4E9D8"/>
  <ellipse cx="146" cy="232" rx="16" ry="7" fill="#F4E9D8"/>
  <!-- arm -->
  <path d="M245 170 Q275 160 290 175" stroke="#B08968" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="270" cy="135" r="30" fill="#C9A27E"/>
  <!-- ears swept back -->
  <path d="M255 112 Q215 70 175 78 Q215 95 250 122 Z" fill="#C9A27E"/>
  <path d="M250 110 Q220 82 192 83 Q222 98 247 118 Z" fill="#E8A5A0"/>
  <path d="M268 106 Q240 60 200 58 Q238 80 262 116 Z" fill="#B08968"/>
  <!-- goggles -->
  <rect x="255" y="120" width="40" height="18" rx="9" fill="#2B1B4A"/>
  <circle cx="275" cy="129" r="10" fill="#7FD1E8" stroke="#F4E9D8" stroke-width="3"/>
  <path d="M255 128 L240 130" stroke="#2B1B4A" stroke-width="5"/>
  <!-- nose & grin -->
  <circle cx="298" cy="142" r="4" fill="#E8576B"/>
  <path d="M282 150 Q290 158 298 150" stroke="#2B1B4A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
```

Want me to save it into the repo as a file, or adjust the pose, palette, or add a background like a looping track?
